name: Microsoft News Dataset (MIND)
description: A large-scale news recommendation benchmark containing user click histories, news articles, and impression logs. MIND supports personalized news recommendation research; this record describes the dataset only and does not distribute its data.
citation: Wu, F., Qiao, Y., Chen, J.-H., Wu, C., Qi, T., Lian, J., Liu, D., Xie, X., Gao, J., Wu, W., & Zhou, M. (2020). MIND: A Large-scale Dataset for News Recommendation. Proceedings of the 58th Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics, 3597–3606. https://doi.org/10.18653/v1/2020.acl-main.331
